```{r setup3}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(phyloseq)
library(randomcoloR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r setup4}
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fconstancias/metabaRpipe-source/master/Rscripts/functions.R")
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fconstancias/DivComAnalyses/master/R/phyloseq_biobakery_functions.R")
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fconstancias/DivComAnalyses/master/R/phyloseq_varia.R")

```

```{r setup5}
pd <- position_dodge(0)
```

```{r transform metaphlan merged abundance table into phyloseq object}
ps <- "/Volumes/lnp524/PhD/Puplications/Inflammation_trajectories/00_raw_data/merged_abundance_table.txt" %>%
metaphlan_2phyloseq(merged_metaphlan = .)

# Calling the first few sample names
ps %>% 
  sample_names() %>% 
  head()
```

```{r refine sample name}
ps %>% 
  sample_names() %>% 
  str_extract(.,"[^_]+") %>% 
  str_remove_all(., "[A-Z]")  -> sample_names(ps)

ps %>% 
  sample_names() %>% 
  head()
```

```{r upload metadata table}
meta <- '/Volumes/lnp524/PhD/Puplications/Inflammation_trajectories/00_raw_data/Metadata.xlsx' %>%
  read_excel

meta %>% 
  DT::datatable()
```

```{r merge phyloseq object with metadata}
ps <- ps %>% 
      physeq_add_metadata(metadata = meta,
                      sample_column = "ID")
```

```{r add S_ to the beginning of ID names}
# Phyloseq prefers samples names that does not start with a number
ps %>% 
  sample_names() %>% 
  paste0("S_", .) -> sample_names(ps)

ps %>% 
  sample_names() %>% 
  head()
```

```{r Modify metadata within phyloseq object}
ps_up <- ps %>% 
  microViz::ps_mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("TP1", "TP2", "TP3")),
                      Period = Time,
                      Period = recode(Period, TP1 = "Baseline", TP2 = "Week 2", TP3 = "Week 4"), 
                      time = parse_number(as.character(Time)),
                      Sample_Type =  Sample,
                      Sex = recode(sex, Male = 1, Female = 2),
                      Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("1", "2")), 
                      Sample = factor(Sample, levels = c("Saliva", "Plaque")),
                      Subject = fct_relevel(Subject, "D01"))
```

```{r save phyloseq object to dataframe}
dfdf <- ps_up %>% 
  sample_data(.) %>% 
  data.frame() 

dfdf %>% 
  DT::datatable()
```

```{r generate subject color palette}
ps_up %>% 
  generate_color_palette(var = "Subject",
                         pal = "randomcoloR",
                         print = TRUE, runTsne = TRUE) -> sub_pal
```

```{r delta mean plaque and BOP% - normalized to baseline}
meta <- ps_up %>%
  sample_data() %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Select important columns and transform to long format
meta_long <- meta %>%
  select(sample_id, Sample, Subject, Time, time, starts_with("mean")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean"))

meta_long %>% 
  group_by(name, Subject) %>% 
  arrange(time) %>%
  mutate(delta = value - first(value)) -> meta_long_delta # adding extra column where the value of TP1 is subtracted 
                                                          # from the values at TP2 and TP3, separately. 
```

```{r ratio mean plaque and BOP% - normalized to baseline}
meta_long %>%
  group_by(name, Subject) %>%
  arrange(time) %>%
  mutate(ratio = value / first(value)) -> meta_long_ratio # adding extra column where the value of TP1 is divided
                                                          # with the values at TP2 and TP3, separately. 
```

```{r Adding delta- and ratio values to phyloseq object, warning=FALSE}
meta_long_delta %>% 
  select(-value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "delta") %>%
  rename_at(vars(starts_with('mean')), funs(paste0('delta_', .))) %>% # Add "delta" to every column header that
                                                                      # starts with "mean"
  select(sample_id, delta_mean_plaque, delta_mean_bleeding) %>% # Select delta values and identifier
  full_join(.,
            meta_long_ratio %>% # join to table with ratio values
  select(-value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "ratio") %>% # Add "delta" to every column header that
                                                              # starts with "mean"
  rename_at(vars(starts_with('mean')), funs(paste0('ratio_', .))) %>%
  select(sample_id, ratio_mean_plaque, ratio_mean_bleeding)) -> tmp # Select ratio values and identifier
                                                                    # Now tmp is a table with the delta and ratio
                                                                    # for mean bleeding and mean plaque

ps_up %>%
  sample_data() %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(.,
            tmp) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") -> sample_data(ps_up) # join tmp values to ps_up phyloseq object, so all the
                                                        # information are together
```

```{r clustering week 2 samples manually - delta of plaque and BOP%}
result_clust <- meta_long_delta %>% # take values from the delta table 
  filter(Sample == "Plaque", # same clinical values for saliva and plaque samples, as they both come from the same subject
         Time == "TP2") %>% # select only TP2 samples 
  select(-value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "delta") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Subject") %>% 
  select(sample_id, mean_plaque, mean_bleeding) %>% 
  arrange(mean_bleeding) 

# Selecting three participants for the three response groups 
# Fast = 15 
# Moderate = 10 
# Slow = 15
result_clust <- result_clust %>%
  mutate(Inflammation_response = case_when(
    row_number() <= 14 ~ "Slow",
    row_number() <= 15 ~ "Moderate", # Subjects D41 and D44 have the same delta_bleeding value. By default, D41 is placed in the moderate group, whereas D44 is placed in the slow group. In Lundtorp-Olsen 2024, these two subjects are grouped opposite. 
    row_number() <= 16 ~ "Slow", 
    row_number() <= 25 ~ "Moderate",
    TRUE ~ "Rapid"
  )) 
```

```{r adding clustering to phyloseq object}
result_clust <- result_clust %>%
  rownames_to_column("Subject")
# 
# head(meta$Subject)
# 
meta2 <- meta %>%
  left_join(result_clust %>% select(Subject, Inflammation_response),
            by = "Subject")

meta2 <- meta2 %>% 
  select(Subject, sample_id, Inflammation_response)

ps_up %>%
  sample_data() %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(.,
            meta2) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") -> sample_data(ps_up)
```

```{r generate Inflammation_response color palette}
ps_up %>%
  generate_color_palette(var = "Inflammation_response", 
                         pal = c("#00A1D5FF", "#79AF97FF", "#DF8F44FF"), 
                         print = TRUE, runTsne = TRUE) -> infl_pal

#Colors found here (a part of the jama palette) https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/r-color-palettes/discrete/ggsci/default_jama/
```

```{r clusters}
p_cluster <- result_clust %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_plaque, y = mean_bleeding, color = Inflammation_response)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Subject), box.padding = 0.3) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "Slow" = "#79AF97FF",
  "Moderate" = "#00A1D5FF",
  "Rapid" = "#DF8F44FF")) + 
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Inflammation_response), linetype = 2) + 
  ylab("Difference in BOP%") + xlab("Difference in plaque accumulation") 

p_cluster
```

```{r difference in BOP%}
meta <- ps_up %>% 
  sample_data() %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Select important columns and transform to long format
meta_long <- meta %>% 
  select(sample_id, Sample, Subject, Time, time, mean_bleeding, Inflammation_response) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean_bleeding)

meta_long_delta <- meta_long %>% 
  group_by(name, Subject) %>% 
  arrange(time) %>%
  mutate(delta = value - first(value))

meta_long_delta <- meta_long_delta %>%
  mutate(Inflammation_response = factor(
    Inflammation_response,
    levels = c("Slow", "Moderate", "Rapid")
  ))

meta_long_delta %>% 
  filter(Sample == "Plaque") %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(x=Time, y=delta)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Inflammation_response),  position = pd) +
  geom_line(aes(group=Subject), position = pd, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Time, Inflammation_response), 
                   fill = Inflammation_response), position = pd, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15) + 
  theme(strip.placement = "outside") +
  ylab("BOP%") + xlab("Time of sampling") + 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("TP1", "TP2", "TP3"), labels = c("Baseline", 
                                                               "Week 2", "Week 4")) + 
  theme_linedraw() + theme(strip.placement = "outside") + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  scale_color_manual(name = "Responder group", values = infl_pal) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Responder group", values = infl_pal)-> p_bop_delta 

p_bop_delta
```

```{r difference in plaque accumulation}
meta <- ps_up %>% 
  sample_data() %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Select important columns and transform to long format
meta_long <- meta %>% 
  select(sample_id, Sample, Subject, Time, time, mean_plaque, Inflammation_response) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean_plaque)

meta_long_delta <- meta_long %>% 
  group_by(name, Subject) %>% 
  arrange(time) %>%
  mutate(delta = value - first(value))

meta_long_delta <- meta_long_delta %>%
  mutate(Inflammation_response = factor(
    Inflammation_response,
    levels = c("Slow", "Moderate", "Rapid")
  ))

meta_long_delta %>% 
  filter(Sample == "Plaque") %>% 
  ggplot(data = ., aes(x=Time, y=delta)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Inflammation_response),  position = pd) +
  geom_line(aes(group=Subject), position = pd, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Time, Inflammation_response), 
                   fill = Inflammation_response), position = pd, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15) + 
  theme(strip.placement = "outside") +
  ylab("Supragingival plaque accumulation") + xlab("Time of sampling") + 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("TP1", "TP2", "TP3"), labels = c("Baseline", 
                                                               "Week 2", "Week 4")) + 
  theme_linedraw() + theme(strip.placement = "outside") + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  #scale_color_manual(values = infl_pal) + 
  scale_color_manual(name = "Responder group", values = infl_pal) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Responder group", values = infl_pal)-> p_plaque_delta 

p_plaque_delta
```

```{r}

p_boxplot
```

```{r creating future delta BOP for baseline comparisons}
# MetaPhlAn4
# Extract week 2 values for each participant
week2_delta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_up)) %>%
  filter(Period == "Week 2") %>%
  distinct(Subject, delta_mean_bleeding)

# Add future delta BOP to all samples
sample_data(ps_up)$future_delta_mean_bleeding <-
  week2_delta$delta_mean_bleeding[match(sample_data(ps_up)$Subject, week2_delta$Subject)]
```
